name: Crypto and Digital Assets
summary: Equity, debt or fund exposure to crypto businesses and assets: exchanges and custodians, payment-stablecoin issuers, token projects, crypto lenders and levered vehicles, miners, and funds holding crypto. Exchange and custodian failure is a base rate, not a tail (18 of 40 early Bitcoin exchanges closed; Mt. Gox, QuadrigaCX, FTX). The diligence spine is proving solvency, not holdings: proof of reserves AND proof of liabilities at the same block with a challenge string we supply, customer assets segregated at an independent custodian, keys under a tested multi-person quorum, GENIUS Act 1:1 HQLA reserves for payment stablecoins with instrument-level attestation and redemption terms, yield decomposed into organic income vs subsidy, token unlock/emission schedules against real volume, wallet-level user vs speculator analysis, address-level OFAC screening and on-chain tracing of crypto-derived funds, margin/haircut spiral stress for lenders, and governance basics (CFO, controller, audit committee, internal audit, employee census). Absence of an SEC case is not compliance.
one_check: Prove solvency, not holdings: reserves AND liabilities at the same block, with a challenge string we supplied, customer assets segregated at an independent custodian, and keys under a tested multi-person quorum.

subtypes.name: Exchange or custodian
subtypes.description: Holds customer assets; three failure types all observed: bank run on fractional reserves, operator fraud/Ponzi, hack (including insiders). Proof of reserves AND liabilities, segregation and key quorum are gating.

subtypes.name: Stablecoin issuer or tokenized cash / yield-bearing dollar
subtypes.description: Payment stablecoins under the GENIUS Act must be backed 1:1 by HQLA, held for holders, audited, unencumbered. Algorithmic, crypto-collateralized and synthetic designs sit outside the segregated-reserve frameworks and are a higher risk class.

subtypes.name: Token project / protocol
subtypes.description: Token as platform membership; risks are user vs speculator mix, wash trading, unlock/emission schedules, smart-contract security, subsidized yield and pump-and-dump dynamics.

subtypes.name: Crypto lender or levered crypto vehicle
subtypes.description: Margin and loss spirals (Brunnermeier-Pedersen); Celsius and Three Arrows named as failures (no case detail sourced: GAP). Haircut schedules, collateral stress and rehypothecation.

subtypes.name: Mining / validator operations
subtypes.description: Power-intensive operations (ERCOT forecasts 33 GW of new DC and crypto-mining demand by 2031). The bible has no mining-specific benchmarks: thin coverage; power items cross-refer to energy-infrastructure.json and data-centers.json, and validator-attack risk to token economics.

subtypes.name: Fund or vehicle holding crypto (including theme vehicles)
subtypes.description: Fund or SPV holding tokens or crypto equity; custody, valuation (last round is not a mark), bubble/theme-launch timing and investor-level crypto source-of-funds tracing.

intake_questions.question: What is the exposure: equity in an exchange/custodian, stablecoin issuer, token project, lender, miner, or a fund/SPV holding crypto?
intake_questions.why: Sets the subtype and which solvency, reserve or token-economics tests apply (11.1).

intake_questions.question: Does the business hold customer assets? If so, where, under whose keys, and are they segregated at an independent custodian?
intake_questions.why: Customer assets at an affiliate is the FTX failure (11.1.8).

intake_questions.question: Does any product pay a yield? What is its source?
Is any stablecoin issued, held as treasury or taken as collateral? Is it a regulated payment stablecoin?
intake_questions.why: Triggers the GENIUS Act reserve test and run-vulnerability scoring (11.1.6).

intake_questions.question: Is there a token? What is the full unlock and emission schedule?
Does the business lend, borrow or run leverage against crypto collateral?
Do any investors, sponsors or counterparties derive wealth or funds from crypto?
intake_questions.why: Triggers wallet-control proof and on-chain tracing (11.1.9).

intake_questions.question: Does the operation consume large amounts of power (mining, validators)?
intake_questions.why: Pull in power-contract checks from the energy and data-center libraries.

requests.request: Provide proof of reserves AND proof of liabilities dated to the same block height.
requests.format: Signed-message/payment-to-self reserve proof plus Merkle-sum-tree liabilities proof with signed root, same block.
requests.why: Proof of reserves alone is half a proof; reserves can be borrowed for the snapshot.
requests.pass: Both proofs at the same block; assets >= liabilities per asset.
requests.fail: Reserves only; different dates; assets < liabilities.

requests.request: Provide the key-control summary: hot/cold wallet split, signer list, quorum (t-of-n), and geographic separation of signers.
requests.pass: Separate hot and cold keys; cold keys split by threshold sharing or multisig; no single person can move funds.
requests.fail: Single key holder or undocumented quorum.
requests.verify: Key-ceremony documents and live quorum test (confirmatory).

requests.request: Identify the CFO, controller, head of internal audit and audit committee members.
requests.format: Names, CVs, appointment dates, audit committee charter.
requests.why: FTX had no accounting department, internal audit or experienced finance leadership.
requests.pass: CFO and controller in-house; internal audit function; audit committee constituted.
requests.fail: Any missing; accounting fully outsourced with no in-house controller.

requests.request: Disclose all affiliated trading firms and market makers, with any credit lines, privileged access or exit routes they hold.
requests.why: Customer funds diverted to Alameda; privileged exit routes in Terra.
requests.pass: No affiliate with privileged access or credit from customer assets.
requests.fail: Affiliated trading firm with credit lines or privileged exit.
requests.verify: On-chain flow review and bank records.

requests.request: Provide a regulatory-status memo by jurisdiction, not relying on absence of SEC action.
requests.format: Counsel memo listing licences and pending matters.
requests.why: 'No SEC action' offered as compliance (Coinbase dismissal 'not a judgment on the merits').
requests.pass: Licences identified; compliance rests on custody, audit and on-chain verification.
requests.fail: Absence of enforcement cited as compliance.

requests.request: For any yield product, provide a decomposition of yield into organic income versus subsidy/emissions, and the subsidy runway.
requests.format: Monthly table with sources of funds.
requests.why: Terra: 19.5% yield funded by a subsidy reaching ~$6M/day.
requests.pass: Yield covered by organic income, or subsidy runway exceeds hold period and is disclosed.
requests.fail: No organic source; subsidy with no runway.
requests.verify: Recompute from on-chain and accounting data.

requests.request: For a stablecoin, provide the latest reserve attestation with date, auditor, custodian list and instrument-level composition.
requests.why: Undated, unaudited or non-instrument-level reserve claims.
requests.pass: Dated attestation by a named auditor; instrument-level; 1:1 HQLA.

requests.request: For any token, provide the full unlock and emission schedule (team, investors, treasury, staking rewards) against current float and average daily volume.
requests.pass: No unlock in the hold period above several days of real volume.
requests.fail: Unlock above several days of real volume in hold period.

requests.request: Provide the balance sheet showing customer assets and matching customer liabilities, reconciled.
requests.format: Audited or management balance sheet with reconciliation.
requests.why: FTX did not record customer deposits on main entities' balance sheets.
requests.pass: Customer assets and liabilities both recorded and reconcile.
requests.fail: Customer assets off balance sheet or unreconciled.

requests.request: Provide valuation support not based on the last funding round.
requests.why: Last-round valuation is not a mark (FTX $32B).
requests.pass: Valuation rests on cash flows, on-chain metrics or comparables.

requests.request: For lenders/levered vehicles, provide the haircut/margin schedule and a stress of a simultaneous 20%-30% collateral price fall plus a haircut increase, showing what is sold first and covenant effects.
requests.pass: Solvent and liquid through the stress; no cross-covenant breach.
requests.fail: Insolvency or forced sales breaching covenants.

requests.request: Score each money-like product (stablecoin, tokenized MMF, yield-bearing dollar) on the five JFC run-vulnerability features.
requests.why: Liquidity transformation plus threshold effect plus reactive holders invite runs.
requests.pass: Few of the five features present, or mitigants documented.
requests.fail: Liquidity transformation plus threshold effect plus reactive investors.

requests.request: Stress the stablecoin redemption path: what backs the peg (reserves vs sister token) and redemption under a run.
requests.pass: Peg backed by HQLA; redemptions met in stress.

requests.request: For theme/crypto vehicles, compare entry valuation to sector history and to the theme's media and fund-launch peak; apply the four-feature bubble test.
requests.why: Thematic launches buy at the top (~30% risk-adjusted underperformance over five years).
requests.pass: Entry not at theme peak; bubble features absent or priced.

requests.request: State co-investors' exit plans and timing assumptions where a sophisticated investor's participation is cited as validation.
requests.pass: Not relied on as evidence of value.

requests.request: Sign our (or an independent party's) challenge string with the reserve keys and complete a payment-to-self at the snapshot block.
requests.pass: Valid signatures over our challenge from every reserve address.

requests.request: Provide the Merkle-sum-tree liabilities proof with signed root and enable inclusion checks for a sample of real customer accounts we select.
requests.pass: Sample accounts verify inclusion; every node sums correctly; no negative balances.

requests.request: Provide on-chain flow history for reserve addresses for 30 days before and after the attestation date.
requests.why: Reserves funded just before and drained after the snapshot.
requests.pass: No material inflows before or outflows after unexplained.

requests.request: Provide a liabilities schedule including derivatives, loans and fiat, not just spot crypto.
Provide the independent custodian agreement showing customer-asset segregation.
requests.pass: Customer assets at an independent custodian, segregated.
requests.fail: Self-custody or affiliate custody of customer assets.

requests.request: Provide the auditor's engagement and last audit opinion, demonstrating crypto-custody competence and scope covering customer-asset segregation.
requests.pass: Reputable auditor with crypto-custody experience; segregation in scope.

requests.request: Provide key-ceremony documentation for all cold wallets.
Perform a live withdrawal test demonstrating the stated quorum is enforced.
requests.pass: Withdrawal fails below quorum and succeeds at quorum.

requests.request: Provide the signer list with geographic separation and succession plan.
Provide smart-contract audit reports for all deployed contracts.
requests.format: Third-party audit reports with remediation status.
requests.verify: Verify deployed bytecode matches audited code.

requests.request: Provide hack/incident history and security controls (insider threat included).
Provide evidence that reserves are 1:1 HQLA (cash, demand deposits, short-dated Treasuries, repo, eligible MMFs), held for holders, and not lent, pledged or rehypothecated (GENIUS Act).
Provide redemption terms and timing for non-retail holders.
Provide reserve reports against AICPA reserve-report criteria (March 2025).
Provide controls that keep reserves between reports (daily reconciliation, custodian access).
Confirm regulated payment-stablecoin status, or classify as unregulated/offshore (higher risk class).
Provide wallet-level analysis separating real users (fees paid for use) from speculators and exchange-to-exchange transfers.
requests.why: Volume mostly exchange churn has no user floor.
requests.pass: Material share of activity from actual platform use.

requests.request: Provide on-chain liquidity depth and holder distribution.
requests.pass: Depth and distribution consistent with claims.

requests.request: Provide wash-trading detection analysis covering market-making wallets (15-25 wallet patterns), anchor swaps, self-dealt liquidity and bundled launches.
requests.why: Fake market making and rug pulls.

requests.request: Provide turnover relative to fundamentals.
requests.why: Turnover far above fundamentals is a bubble signature (Chinese warrants 328%/day).

requests.request: Provide marketing materials and social-media promotion record.
requests.why: Pump-and-dump: high returns with 'no additional risk'.
requests.pass: No such claims; product and cash flow identifiable.

requests.request: Provide large-holder flow monitoring and list of privileged exit routes.
requests.pass: Monitoring in place; no privileged routes.

requests.request: Assess validator/miner attack risk for the network.
Provide loan book with collateral, rehypothecation status and counterparties.
Provide an employee census reconciled to payroll.
requests.why: FTX could not list its own employees.

requests.request: Provide accounting infrastructure description (GL system, close process, who performs it).
Provide address-level OFAC/SDN screening policy and results for all counterparties and treasury addresses.
requests.why: Name-only screening misses SDN crypto addresses; Lazarus laundering.
requests.pass: Address-level screening with no hits or resolved hits.

requests.request: For any investor or counterparty with crypto-derived funds, provide wallet addresses and a signed message proving control.
Provide exchange account statements and KYC records for fiat on-ramps.
requests.why: Gaps in the trail to fiat.

requests.request: Document the judgment on any mixer or privacy-protocol exposure as an escalation.
Provide bank and fiat relationships and customer fiat balances.
For mining, provide power contracts, firm vs curtailable terms and energization schedule (apply data-center and energy power checks).
requests.pass: Executed power by MW and date.

requests.request: For mining, provide equipment (miner) purchase orders and serial-level inventory.
Commission an on-chain tracing report from an analytics vendor covering full history to fiat on-ramps, with mixer, darknet, SDN-address and high-risk exchange exposure.
requests.why: Low taint score is not proof of clean funds; heuristics produce false positives.

requests.request: Commission an independent crypto-custody auditor to review PoR/PoL methodology, liabilities coverage and auditor scope.
Commission an independent smart-contract audit or review of existing audits.
Commission an on-chain market analytics review (wash trading, user vs speculator, liquidity depth, holder distribution).
Commission a key-management/security assessment.
Obtain regulatory counsel opinion on licensing and stablecoin status.
Deliver a fresh PoR + PoL at a block within 5 days of closing, with our challenge string.
Deliver custody agreement executed and assets transferred to the independent custodian.
Provide quarterly PoR + PoL with independent challenge strings.
Provide monthly stablecoin reserve attestations.
Provide monthly large-holder flow, unlock and subsidy runway reports.
requests.why: Run signals (Terra pre-run signals were visible).

requests.request: Provide annual quorum re-test and signer changes.
Provide weekly margin/haircut and collateral reports.

kill_tests.test: Proof of reserves offered without proof of liabilities, or the challenge string is supplied by the exchange.
One person can move customer or treasury funds (no tested multi-person quorum).
Customer assets held by an affiliate or commingled, not at an independent custodian.
No accounting function, no in-house controller/CFO, or no audit committee.
Payment stablecoin reserves not 1:1 HQLA, encumbered, or attested undated/unaudited.
Yield with no organic source and no subsidy runway.
Crypto-derived funds with no wallet addresses, no signed message, or unresolved SDN-address exposure.

red_flags.flag: Proof of reserves with no proof of liabilities, or a challenge string supplied by the exchange.
red_flags.check: Both proofs, same block, our challenge.

red_flags.flag: Reserve addresses funded just before the attestation and drained after.
No in-house controller or CFO; no internal audit; no employee census.
An affiliated trading firm with privileged exit or credit lines.
A yield with no organic source, or a subsidy with no runway.
A stablecoin backed by a sister token, or a reserve report that is undated, unaudited, or not at instrument level.
Volume that is mostly exchange-to-exchange churn.
An unlock or emission above several days of real volume inside the hold period.
Returns marketed as high with 'no additional risk'; price moves unexplained by fundamentals; heavy social-media promotion.
'No SEC action' offered as evidence of compliance.
Source-of-wealth story with no wallet addresses, no signed message, or a mixer history waved away.
Fake market-making through 15 to 25 wallets, speculative 'anchor swaps', self-dealt liquidity, bundled launches, rug pulls (WEAK internal file).
Last-round valuation used as the mark.
Customer deposits not recorded on the balance sheet.
Sanctions screening at name level only.
Secondary trading/redemption mismatch: token or coin redeemable only via secondary market.
A sophisticated co-investor's presence cited as proof of value.

metrics.acceptable: 18 of 40 Bitcoin exchanges closed through failure or inability to pay (2013 study)
metrics.source: Moore and Christin via Narayanan et al., ch. 4.4

metrics.metric: Proof of reserves and liabilities timing

metrics.acceptable: 1:1 HQLA (cash, demand deposits, short-dated Treasuries, repo, certain MMFs), unencumbered
metrics.source: GENIUS Act (via Circle FY2025 annual report; HLS Forum 2026; confirm against statute)
Wharton BDAP Stablecoin Toolkit 2026 (confirm on aicpa-cima.com)

metrics.acceptable: Few of five: liquidity transformation, threshold effects, money-like use, contagion channels, reactive investors
Simultaneous 20%-30% collateral price fall plus haircut increase; must remain solvent and liquid
No unlock/emission above several days of real average daily volume within hold period
Chinese warrants turned over 328% a day with near-zero fundamental value
Terra Anchor 19.5% yield; subsidy ~$6M/day by April 2022
Thematic ETFs lose ~30% risk-adjusted over first five years
Escalation with documented judgment, not automatic pass/fail

third_party_reports.report: On-chain tracing report (full history to fiat; mixer, darknet, SDN, high-risk exchange exposure)
PoR/PoL methodology review and custody audit
third_party_reports.required_when: Any entity holding customer assets; funds

third_party_reports.report: Market analytics (wash trading, user vs speculator, depth, holder distribution)

hard_questions.question: Show proof of reserves and proof of liabilities at the same block height, with our challenge string.
hard_questions.good_answer: Both proofs produced at a block we choose, signed over our string, with sample-account inclusion checks passing.

hard_questions.question: Who holds keys, what is the quorum, and where are the signers? Show the key-ceremony record.
hard_questions.good_answer: Named signers in separate locations, t-of-n quorum, ceremony record, and an offer to witness a live test.

hard_questions.question: Where is the yield coming from, and how long can the subsidy run?
hard_questions.good_answer: A monthly decomposition showing organic income covers the yield, or a disclosed runway longer than the hold.

hard_questions.question: What backs the peg, who audits it, as of what date, and how fast can a non-retail holder redeem?
hard_questions.good_answer: 1:1 HQLA, named auditor, attestation within the month, redemption T+0/T+1 for non-retail.

hard_questions.question: Who is your controller, who is on the audit committee, and who audits customer-asset segregation?
hard_questions.good_answer: Named in-house controller, independent audit committee members, a crypto-competent auditor with segregation in scope.

hard_questions.question: What share of volume is from real users rather than transfers between exchanges?
hard_questions.good_answer: Wallet-level analysis by a third party.

hard_questions.question: Show the full unlock and emission schedule against daily volume.
hard_questions.good_answer: Schedule with no unlock above several days of real volume in the hold.

hard_questions.question: For crypto-derived wealth: show the wallets, sign a message, and let us trace to fiat.
hard_questions.good_answer: Addresses, signed messages and consent to our vendor tracing.

hard_questions.question: What happens to the loan book if collateral falls 30% and haircuts rise at the same time?
hard_questions.good_answer: A stress showing solvency, sale order and no covenant breach.

hard_questions.question: Which affiliated firms have privileged exit routes or credit lines?

failure_cases.what_happened: Largest exchange became insolvent without being able to explain where the coins went.
failure_cases.check: Proof of reserves AND liabilities; independent custody.

failure_cases.case: 18 of 40 Bitcoin exchanges (Moore and Christin study)
failure_cases.what_happened: Closed through failure or inability to pay customers.
failure_cases.check: Treat exchange failure as a base rate, not a tail.

failure_cases.what_happened: CEO and reportedly sole key holder died; OSC found a Ponzi with fictitious balances credited to aliases; at least C$169M client losses.
failure_cases.check: Key-ceremony documentation; tested quorum; no single key holder; proof of liabilities.

failure_cases.what_happened: Anchor paid 19.5% funded by ~$6M/day subsidy; run began May 7 when two addresses pulled 375M UST; LUNA supply 1B to 6T in three days; sophisticated wallets exited first; Alameda most UST-LUNA swaps; pre-run on-chain signals visible.
failure_cases.check: Yield decomposition and subsidy runway; what backs the peg; large-holder flow monitoring; privileged exit routes.

failure_cases.what_happened: Briefly broke its peg and recovered.
failure_cases.check: Instrument-level reserves, custodian, redemption terms and timing.

failure_cases.what_happened: Customer deposits routed to and used by Alameda; no accounting department, no internal audit, no employee list; customer deposits not on main balance sheets; raised $400M at $32B; SBF sentenced to 25 years (March 2024).
failure_cases.check: Proof of liabilities; segregation at independent custodian; crypto-competent auditor; CFO, controller, audit committee; employee census.

failure_cases.what_happened: SEC dismissed its case, 'not a judgment on the merits'.
failure_cases.check: Do not read an absent enforcement action as compliance.

failure_cases.case: Celsius and Three Arrows (GAP: no case detail sourced)
failure_cases.what_happened: Named as earlier failures that may have left unrecognized holes.
